observationsNotFailures: Rig daemon logs 'failed to connect controller|architect shim socket on ready: ... negotiate_protocol timed out after 5000ms' on every boot; identical lines in the implementer's archived run; same best-effort path exists on main (processes.ts markControllerReady); worker-rpc negotiates over a real unix socket in-suite and checkpoints 1-4 passed -> pre-existing rig behaviour, not a transport-split regression.

Environment: this box's global git helper '!gh auth git-credential' currently hangs 30-90 s (gh blocks on the D-Bus secret service), so the rig daemon's first jj git clone was killed at the 30 s runner timeout (launchFailures 1, tree queued); restarted the rig daemon with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/tmp/legion22-smoke/gitconfig (helper-free copy of ~/.gitconfig, same workaround the LEGION-21 tester used) after removing the half-written clone dir; the clone then succeeded and admission reconciliation re-spawned the tree on boot.
The smoke rig is single-occupancy (shared ports, shared LEGSMOKE project, shared private tmux server); waited for the LEGION-21 tester's rig to tear down (10:47:37Z) before starting.

Tester grant's gh identity cannot create check runs (403) and the commit status it created is attributed to legion-implementer[bot]; github-apps.ts MODE_TO_ROLE maps test -> review. Not changed by this PR.
